source.title: VWAP hunt 2026-10-20 (owner's brief, idea 6): A gap left by the side that holds the session's average price is its unfilled demand; the return to it meets that interest. Who loses: the traders fading the session's volume side into the gap.

entry.words: A fair value gap at least 0.1 x ATR(14): a limit at its near edge, with the gap, a buy only above the session VWAP and a sell only below; the newest gap replaces the order; no new order from 15:00. stop 25 / target 37.5 points; at most 3 a pass; flat 15:58.

taught: [owner 2026-10-20, brief prompt-vwap-5-10-a-day-3to1-blocks, idea 6] A fair value gap at least 0.1 x ATR(14): a limit at its near edge, with the gap, a buy only above the session VWAP and a sell only below; the newest gap replaces the order; no new order from 15:00.

[owner 2026-10-20, brief section 3] versions: bars 1 / 5 / 15, NY cash and London / overnight where the family runs, stops 25 / 30 / 40 and a structure stop, target 1.5 x the stop: this sheet is bars 5, stop 25 / target 37.5 points
not_run: PRE-REGISTERED in out/vwap_hunt_2026-10-20/PREREG.md before any run; nothing tuned on a result.
1-MINUTE SHEETS run the New York passes only (machine time); 5 / 15-minute sheets every pass the family runs except pre (08:25-09:30), which the brief does not ask for.
THE SESSION VWAP of the engine restarts at every pass start (09:30, 11:00, 13:30; 03:00 London; 00:00 Asia; 18:00 evening); 'rth' / 'us' anchors stay at 09:30 for the New York passes.
THE CAP: 3 trades per session pass (several passes: a day can hold more, and a trade of one pass may still be open when the next pass enters).
COSTS AND FILLS: the engine's own (1 tick of slippage, $4 a round turn, tick replay).
THE TEST DAYS are read only by `bp.py taught wf` (the 3:1 block walk-forward, once), its output sent to a log unread until SELECTION.md is written.
